children: DocuSign reported results for the 2026 quarter with revenue of $875.75M, net income of $77.72M and diluted EPS of $0.4, each above the year-ago quarter.
¹ Reported as “Revenue”. ² Reported as “Net income”. ³ Reported as “Diluted income per share attributable to common stockholders”.
Revenue growth of 9% year-over-year was driven by expansion in commercial and enterprise accounts.
DocuSign is investing across direct, partner and digital self-service go-to-market channels to broaden reach and scale its agreement and identity management platform.
Total customers exceeded 1.9M, with roughly 289K direct customers and enterprise customers with >$300K ARR rising to 1,296.

The company is prioritizing its IAM platform strategy and expanding AI and data capabilities for agreement insights, while increasing hosting, cloud migration and capitalized software development to support international growth.
